abstract: A homozygous nonsense mutation (Ter) in murine Dnd1 (Dnd1(Ter/Ter)) results in a significant early loss of primordial germ cells (PGCs) prior to colonization of the gonad in both sexes and all genetic backgrounds tested. The same mutation also leads to testicular teratomas only on the 129Sv/J background. Male mutants on other genetic backgrounds ultimately lose all PGCs with no incidence of teratoma formation. It is not clear how these PGCs are lost or what factors directly control the strain-specific phenotype variation. To determine the mechanism underlying early PGC loss we crossed Dnd1(Ter/Ter) embryos to a Bax-null background and found that germ cells were partially rescued. Surprisingly, on a mixed genetic background, rescued male germ cells also generated fully developed teratomas at a high rate. Double-mutant females on a mixed background did not develop teratomas, but were fertile and produced viable off-spring. However, when Dnd1(Ter/Ter) XX germ cells developed in a testicular environment they gave rise to the same neoplastic clusters as mutant XY germ cells in a testis. We conclude that BAX-mediated apoptosis plays a role in early germ cell loss and protects from testicular teratoma formation on a mixed genetic background.
abstract_ja: Dnd1のホモ接合ナンセンス変異(Ter)を持つマウス(Dnd1(Ter/Ter))では、両性の性別および全ての検査した遺伝的背景において、生殖隆起への定着前に原始胚細胞が顕著に早期消失する。同じ変異は129Sv/J背景の雄でのみ精巣奇形腫を引き起こす。他の背景の雄変異体は原始胚細胞を最終的にすべて失い、奇形腫は形成されない。早期の原始胚細胞消失の機序や、この系統特異的な表現型の違いを直接制御する因子は明らかでない。早期の原始胚細胞消失の機序を明らかにするため、Dnd1(Ter/Ter)胚をBax欠損背景と交配したところ、胚細胞が部分的に救済された。驚くべきことに、混合遺伝的背景の雄では救済された胚細胞からも高率に完全に発達した奇形腫が生じた。混合背景の二重変異体の雌では奇形腫は形成されず、稔性を示し生存可能な子を産生した。しかし、Dnd1(Ter/Ter)のXX胚細胞を精巣環境で発達させると、XY変異体の胚細胞と同じ腫瘍性の細胞塊を生じた。BAX媒介性アポトーシスは早期の胚細胞消失に関与し、混合遺伝的背景において精巣奇形腫の形成を防ぐと結論する。
